subject: PivotalWorks onboarding — PO instructions, payment window, and early-pay options
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah@pivotalworks.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@pivotalworks.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PivotalWorks onboarding: PO instructions & payment cadence

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the welcome call yesterday. We're ready to get set up as a Redwood vendor so we can receive POs and submit invoices. A few quick items from our side:

- Preferred invoicing cadence: monthly, consolidated per contract number.
- Default payment preference: Net 45 is what our accounting team typically takes, but we can accept Net 30 if necessary.
- We can provide a W-9 and bank-ACH stub.

Can you confirm: where should we send invoices (email or portal), are POs required for every invoice, and whether Redwood participates in any early-pay programs (discount-for-early-pay)? If so, what does that process look like?

Attaching our standard vendor intake packet to this message for your AP intake.

Attachments: vendor-intake-pivotalworks.pdf

Best,
Sarah Li
Head of Finance Operations
PivotalWorks LLC
phone: +1 415-555-0199
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah@pivotalworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PivotalWorks onboarding: PO instructions & payment cadence

Sarah —

Thanks for sending the packet and for the clear notes. Quick answers and a couple asks from our side:

1) Invoices: please upload invoices to our vendor portal (link below) *and* email AP at finance@redwood.com. Portal upload speeds processing and is required to link to our PO.
2) PO requirement: yes — we issue POs for every engagement. The invoice must include the PO number in the invoice header or it will be routed to manual review (delays).
3) Early-pay program: we do have an early-pay option run through our Treasury partner. Typical structure is a small discount in exchange for pay acceleration (example: 1% fee for payment at day 15 instead of Net 45). Details and eligibility are handled by AP once the vendor is onboarded.

Can you attach a completed vendor portal form (PDF) and the W-9? If you can also indicate whether you prefer Net30 or Net45 for the contract, AP will queue the right approval.

Link: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/new-vendor (please reference deal id PW-3472 in the form)

I'll loop AP and our account manager on the next steps.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Senior Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sarah Li <sarah@pivotalworks.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PivotalWorks onboarding: PO instructions & payment cadence

Hi all —

Looping in AP specifics so we can get PivotalWorks live quickly. AP checklist and notes below:

Required items from vendor to complete setup:
- Completed vendor portal form (PDF) [see attached vendor-portal-form.pdf]
- Signed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- Bank ACH stub or voided check for ACH setup
- Remit-to email and preferred invoice file format (PDF preferred)

Routing/terms notes:
- Default onboarding term is Net45. We can request Net30 approvals for strategic partners (usually requires an account manager endorsement).
- Early-pay program: vendor opts in at onboarding. AP forwards opt-in to Treasury for eligibility and returns a quote (discount % + payment day). The finance team requires the vendor to accept the discount via DocuSign before arranging accelerated payment.
- PO placement: PO must include Vendor Name, Redwood PO number, description of goods/services, and a contract/reference number where applicable. Missing PO numbers add a 2–3 week delay in processing.

If PivotalWorks can provide the vendor packet, W-9, and ACH stub today, we can aim to issue the first PO by EOD tomorrow and process the first invoice on Net45. If Marissa confirms strategic priority, we'll escalate a Net30 approval and question Treasury for an early-pay quote.

Attachments: vendor-portal-form.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference

To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:08:00 -07:00

Thanks — adding a quick note from the account side.

PivotalWorks is on the critical path for feature rollout next month; I'd like to request Net30 as a one-time onboarding concession if they can accept the early-pay opt-in (we'll cover the small discount cost from the partnership onboarding budget). Proposed approach:

- Offer Net30 for the first two invoices if vendor accepts early-pay opt-in at 1% for day-15 payment.
- AP to set vendor up with Net30 tag; Treasury to confirm the exact discount quote.
- PivotalWorks to sign vendor portal form + W-9 + ACH stub and complete DocuSign for early-pay acceptance.

I'll open a short internal approval ticket with Finance (link below) and will confirm by noon once Treasury returns the quote.

Action items for Sarah: please upload the completed vendor-portal-form.pdf, W9-PivotalWorks.pdf, and bank-ACH-stub.pdf to the portal and reply to confirm upload. If you can set remittance to finance@redwood.com we can avoid routing delays.

Internal approval: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/submissions/PW-3472

Thanks —
